[250-FAQ Master Blueprint] Chief AI Architect 6-Layer Zero-Trust Reference Architecture & Selection Guide
Unifying Ingress & Gateway (L1), CDR & Guardrails (L2), Entra OBO Identity (L3), Pre-Filter RAG & HSM/TEE (L4), Sandboxes & Broker (L5), and Audit (L6)
🏆🎉 250 Bilingual FAQs · 528 Scenarios · 1,122 Tests
BRK-509 & BRK-510 · 514 Vectors · 6-Layer Blueprint
1. Master 6-Layer Enterprise AI Defense-in-Depth Architecture & Product Selection Matrix
🌐 L1. Network & AI Gateway Ingress
• Stack: Hub-Spoke VNet + Private Endpoint + Azure APIM / Kong
• Controls: Zero public access, JWT-bound user TPM quotas, clamp
max_completion_tokens (anti-Sponge), acl_hash cache isolation
⏱️ Overhead: ~1-3 ms (Eliminates leaked keys & DoW bill shock)
🛡️ L2. Document CDR & I/O Guardrails
• Stack: Pixel CDR + Document Intelligence + Prompt Shields
• Controls: Flatten PDFs to bitmaps & drop Excel veryHidden tabs;
dual User/Documents Prompt Shields + Spotlighting + Groundedness
⏱️ Overhead: ~30-65 ms (Filters 90%+ jailbreaks & hallucinations)
🪪 L3. Agent Identity & Least-Privilege OBO
• Stack: Microsoft Entra Agent ID + OAuth 2.0 OBO Downscoping
• Controls: Retire shared God-mode Managed Identities internally;
strip user_id from B2C tool schemas & inject from verified JWT
⏱️ Overhead: < 5 ms (Eliminates Confused Deputy & B2C BOLA)
📚 L4. RAG ACL, Lakehouse & Data Sovereignty
• Stack: Purview Labels + AI Search Pre-Filter + Fabric/Unity RLS
• Controls: Ban Post-Filtering; gate ChatBI w/ sqlglot read-only AST;
bind Key Vault Managed HSM CMK (Crypto-Shredding) & H100 TEE
⏱️ Overhead: ~5 ms Pre-Filter (Zero unauthorized chunk recall)
🔒 L5. Sandboxes & Deterministic Capability Broker
• Stack: ACA Dynamic Sessions / Kata + OOB FIDO2 + Broker
• Controls: Zero-cookie MicroVMs for code/web; 100% of writes,
egress & payments gated by Capability Broker & 5-tuple HITL
⏱️ Measured: In-Memory P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite P50 = 7.21 ms
📊 L6. Continuous Red-Teaming, AI-SPM & Audit
• Stack: Promptfoo + Foundry PyRIT + Defender AI-SPM + Sentinel
• Controls: Gate CI/CD on deterministic state receipts; scrub PII
via Presidio and seal receipts in 7-year Purview WORM storage
⏱️ Mode: Async audit pipeline + CI/CD release gates
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Cross-Layer Compound Kill-Chain & Policy Downgrade vs. 6-Layer Blueprint
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Single Guardrail + Shared Identity (BRK-509 / BRK-510 Breach)
1. Compound Kill-Chain (BRK-509): Poisoned document evades single classifier (6.5%+ FN), rides
shared identity to read strategy restricted-budget, alters review business-result & leaks.
2. 6-Layer Policy Downgrade (BRK-510 · 250-FAQ Milestone): Forged Chief Architect waiver
downgrades trust-registry to baseline mode and wires $5,000 advisory fee!
💥 Root Cause: Relying on probabilistic text filters alone without a deterministic action broker!
✅ Chief Architect 6-Layer Zero-Trust Blueprint + Capability Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Perimeter & Data (L1-L4): APIM token clamps, Pixel CDR, Entra OBO & Pre-Filter ACLs
• Deterministic Anchor (L5 Broker): record-owner & untrusted-write halt compound attacks
• Immutable Control Plane (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry against edits
• Treasury & WORM Audit (L5-L6): Blocks $5,000 wire in 0.0248ms & commits signed receipt
🛡️ Total 6-Layer Security Overhead < 3% of a standard 2,500ms LLM generation turn!
🛠️ Phased Enterprise Rollout Roadmap (Day 0 MVP ➔ Day 30 Scale ➔ Day 90 Sovereign Regulated)
🚀 Day 0 (Non-Negotiable MVP): Private Endpoint + APIM JWT/TPM + Entra OBO / Strip user_id + AI Search Pre-Filter + Capability Broker
📈 Day 30 (Enterprise Scale): SharePoint SAM + Purview Labels + Pixel CDR + ACA Hyper-V Code/Browser Sandboxes + CI/CD Promptfoo/PyRIT
🏦 Day 90 (Regulated Sovereign): Key Vault Managed HSM CMK (Crypto-Shredding) + Confidential GPU TEE (H100) + OOB FIDO2 + WORM Audit
